entries.text: list_tickets: status=None returns all tickets. Keep owner exact matching, ascending id ordering, no input mutation, and independent result row dictionaries.

Optional status is a string: strip whitespace and lowercase, then allow only open or closed. Combine status and owner with AND. Unknown, empty or non-string status raises ValueError, even for empty input.
Regression contract: unknown owner and empty input return an empty list. Owner comparison remains case sensitive.
Unrelated billing module requires integer cents. Do not include this in ticket contexts.
